appearance.description: Theme, language, terminal typography, motion, and assistive features
appearance.languageHint: Changes take effect immediately and are saved automatically.
appearance.languageSaveFailed: Could not save the language setting: {{detail}}

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.hint: Removes movement animations while preserving opacity transitions

screenReader.label: Screen reader mode
screenReader.hint: Enable the terminal accessibility tree and announce status changes

notifications.description: Control status-change notifications and log retention.
notifications.systemHint: Send system notifications when status changes (in-app unread indicators always remain active)
notifications.permissionHintMacos: If notifications do not appear, allow AgentPort under System Settings → Notifications. In-app unread indicators are unaffected.
notifications.permissionHintLinux: If notifications do not appear, check that the desktop notification service is available and notify-send is installed. In-app unread indicators are unaffected.
notifications.logLimitHint: Older logs are rotated at the limit, preserving only the newest portion
notifications.terminalCommandHint: Enter a terminal executable name or absolute path. Arguments are not parsed; the target project directory is used as the working directory.

search.description: Control terminal indexing and the terminal renderer.
search.indexHint: Index terminal text (source logs are not modified, and the index can be rebuilt at any time)
search.rebuildStarted: Rebuilding the search index in the background
search.canvasRendererUnavailable: The Canvas renderer is unavailable; using DOM instead: {{detail}}

adapters.description: Automatically detects every registered adapter. When multiple installation paths are found, AgentPort validates them in priority order and selects a working version. Quick-launch icons in project rows follow the same order.
adapters.empty: No Agent CLI has been detected.

secrets.unavailableWarning: System secure storage is unavailable. AgentPort will not fall back to plaintext storage.
secrets.lockedHint: Unlock Keychain / Secret Service in the operating system and try again.
secrets.unavailableHint: Unlock system storage, inject the value through the Shell environment, or remove the related reference.
secrets.valuePlaceholder: Value (written only to system secure storage)
secrets.valueHint: Original values are stored only in macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service. AgentPort stores reference metadata only.
secrets.empty: No sensitive environment variables have been saved. You can continue using the Shell environment.
secrets.deleteBody: This removes it from system secure storage and preset references. Running Sessions are unaffected.

archive.description: Archived Sessions do not appear in the project tree. You can restore or permanently delete them.
archive.deleteBody: This stops any remaining process and permanently deletes the Session's archive record, terminal logs, and search index. This action cannot be undone.
archive.deleteAllBody: This stops any remaining processes and permanently deletes all archive records, terminal logs, and search indexes. This action cannot be undone.
archive.noResults: No archived Sessions match the current filters
archive.restoreFailed: Could not restore the archived Session: {{detail}}
archive.deleteFailed: Could not permanently delete the archived Session: {{detail}}
archive.deleteAllFailed: Could not permanently delete all archived Sessions: {{detail}}

backup.description: Backups include the database and all Session logs. They exclude Worktrees, exports, and Secret values (credentials in system secure storage must be linked again after restore).
backup.createComplete_one: Backup complete: {{count}} file passed integrity verification
backup.createComplete_other: Backup complete: {{count}} files passed integrity verification
backup.restoreTitle: Restore backup to a new directory?
backup.restoreBody: Restore writes to an entirely new data directory and does not modify the data currently in use. When it finishes, quit AgentPort, replace the original data directory with the restored directory, and restart.
backup.createHint: Saved under backups/ in the app data directory and verified automatically
backup.restoreToNew: Restore backup to a new directory…
backup.restoreHint: Does not modify current data; quit the app before replacing the directory
backup.instructionsBeforePath: To use the restored data: 1) quit AgentPort; 2) rename the current data directory
backup.instructionsAfterPath: to keep it as a backup; 3) rename the restored directory to this path; 4) restart AgentPort. Restore does not delete any existing data.
backup.empty: No backups yet. Create a manual backup before upgrading the app.
backup.listFailed: Could not load the backup list: {{detail}}
backup.openDirectoryFailed: Could not open the backup directory: {{detail}}
backup.revealRestoredFailed: Could not show the restored directory: {{detail}}
